{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Confirm the data structure and unique values
print("Data shape:", df.shape)
print("\nUnique arms:", df['arm'].unique())
print("\nUnique severities:", df['severity'].unique())
print("\nUnique responses:", df['responded'].unique())

# Check for duplicate patient_ids
print("\nDuplicate patient_ids:", df['patient_id'].duplicated().sum())

# Identify the highest sample_seq for each patient to keep only the latest test
# Sort by patient_id and sample_seq descending, then drop duplicates on patient_id
df = df.sort_values(['patient_id', 'sample_seq'], ascending=[True, False]).drop_duplicates('patient_id', keep='first')

# Verify the deduplication
print("\nAfter deduplication, shape:", df.shape)

# Now filter for CONTROL-arm patients with MODERATE severity
control_moderate = df[(df['arm'] == 'control') & (df['severity'] == 'moderate')]

# Check how many such patients
print("\nNumber of CONTROL-arm, MODERATE severity patients:", len(control_moderate))

# Compute the fraction who responded
if len(control_moderate) > 0:
    fraction_responded = control_moderate['responded'].mean()
    print(f"\nFraction responded: {fraction_responded}")
else:
    print("\nNo CONTROL-arm, MODERATE severity patients found.")

# Final result
fraction_responded"}
